title: 第19章 分牛问题第20章 无解我有两种解法好吗
slug: 玄幻开局吃软饭出世即儒圣
content_zh:
“文绰这次也是亏大了，本来墨家嫡传之位都是板上钉钉了，没想到……”
“是啊，曹茱萸捅了这么大的篓子，说不得就该被逐出墨家。”
“结果居然被她破开了粉尘爆炸的案子，反倒赢得了裴大人的欣赏。”
“你们刚才是没看到裴大人那眼神，就跟看到了宝一样。”
一方桌上，几个青年男子满脸惋惜，望向面前的黑衣青年孟文绰。
孟文绰倒是面色平静，闻言也只是淡淡一笑。
“曹大人竟然能够更胜一筹，文绰自然甘拜下风，没什么好惋惜的。”
他虽然面色没有表露分毫，可桌面下的双手，却死死的掐在自己的大腿上。
一条条青筋如同小蛇般盘踞在手上，眸光也露出了几分厉色。
墨家嫡传，乃是墨家的储备人才，未来就算不能成为巨子，也得是九算之一。
每年的墨家嫡传都只有一两个名额，必须要墨家九算推举，然后投票决出。
他和曹茱萸都是今年的有力人选，但前段时间，督造司出现了爆炸案。
所有人都认为曹茱萸将会受到严惩，而他则成为了唯一的嫡传人选。
就连他自己都这么认为。
为了这个嫡传名额，他付出了太多心血，宵衣旰食，甚至还有家族的助力。
本以为这次嫡传人选非他莫属，却没有想到……曹茱萸是走了什么狗屎运？
他旁边的青衣女子也同样愤愤不平，揽着他的衣袖，“没事的，文绰哥哥。”
“她有什么本事啊？不就是一个爆炸案吗？文绰哥哥若非钻研学问，早就名甲天下了。”
桌上众人闻言，也都是纷纷点头，毫无疑问，他们是认可孟文绰的。
这并非是趋炎附势，而是孟文绰无论家世还是才情，都的确无可指摘。

他出身的孟家，更是墨家的巨子家族，孟家老祖宗孟胜，就是墨家第三代巨子。
后面孟家虽不及鼎盛时期，却也是墨家中流砥柱。
孟文绰更是青年天骄，被视为孟胜第二，被整个孟家寄予厚望。
孟文绰心中自然愤恨，可此时还是表现出些许风度，与众人饮酒。
但片刻后，这才注意到身边的青衣女子离开许久，都没回来，连忙问道：“如素呢？”
……
“咦！这就是茱萸你在中山郡勾搭的小情郎啊？啧啧啧，怎么找个有妇之夫！”
谢如素缓步走上前来，很自然地坐在沈无名旁边，上下打量着他。
“闭嘴，谢如素。”曹茱萸眉头轻皱，“沈公子是我的至交好友，也是寿亭侯府的姑爷。”
沈无名注意到，曹茱萸似乎不太喜欢谢如素。
不过这似乎也正常，毕竟每一个漂亮的女人，都对同类不太友好。
不过他对曹茱萸说的至交好友身份，却有些不太赞同。
有一说一，他跟这个女人并没有太多交情，甚至还有点想拉开距离。
要不是看在钱的份上，今儿个都不会过来。
“茱萸，不要这么拒人于千里之外嘛。”
谢如素淡淡一笑，然后从袖中取出一张纸。
“主要是听说你最近解开了爆炸案，应该是墨家造诣又有提升。”
“正好我有一个问题，许久未曾解开，不知道能不能来请教一下？”
她说话的时候声音挺大，似乎是故意的，顿时就将周围人的眼神吸引了过来。
毕竟大家都知道，曹茱萸极有可能是墨家嫡传，未来是大家的顶头上司。
content_en:
"Wen Chuo also suffered a big loss this time. Originally, the position of the direct heir of the Mo family was certain, but I didn't expect..."
"Yes, Cao Zhuyu has caused such a big mistake. He should be expelled from the Mo family if he can't do it."
"In the end, she solved the dust explosion case, and actually won the admiration of Mr. Pei."
"You didn't see the look in Master Pei's eyes just now, it was like seeing Bao."
At one table, several young men looked at the young man in black, Meng Wenchuo, with regret on their faces.
Meng Wenchuo's face was calm, and he just smiled lightly when he heard this.
"Master Cao is actually able to be even better, and Wen Chuo is naturally at a disadvantage. There is nothing to regret."
Although his expression didn't show anything, the hands under the table were tightly grasping his thighs.
The veins were coiled on his hands like small snakes, and his eyes showed a bit of sternness.
The direct descendants of the Mo family are the reserve talents of the Mo family. Even if they cannot become giants in the future, they must be one of the nine.
Every year, there are only one or two places for the direct successors of the Mohist family, which must be recommended by the Mohist family and then voted on.
He and Cao Zhuyu are both strong candidates this year, but there was an explosion in the Supervision Department some time ago.
Everyone thought that Cao Zhuyu would be severely punished, and he became the only candidate for direct succession.
Even he thinks so.
For this place of direct succession, he put in a lot of effort, worked hard, had no food and clothing, and even had the help of his family.
I thought that he would be the chosen successor this time, but I didn't expect... What kind of bad luck did Cao Juyu have?
The woman in green next to him was equally indignant and held his sleeve, "It's okay, brother Wenchuo."
"What ability does she have? Isn't it just a bombing case? If Brother Wenchuo hadn't delved into knowledge, he would have become famous all over the world."
Everyone at the table nodded after hearing this. There was no doubt that they recognized Meng Wenchuo.
This is not to follow the trend, but Meng Wenchuo is indeed blameless regardless of his family background or talents.
The Meng family he was born into was a giant family of the Mohist family. Meng Sheng, the ancestor of the Meng family, was the third generation of the Mohist family.
Although the Meng family was not as prosperous as it was in its heyday, it was still the mainstay of the Mohist family.
Meng Wenchuo was even more of a young genius, regarded as the second best in Meng Sheng, and had high hopes from the entire Meng family.
Meng Wenchuo was naturally resentful, but at this time he still showed some grace and drank with everyone.
But after a while, he noticed that the woman in green clothes beside him had left for a long time and had not come back, so he quickly asked: "Where is Rusu?"
…
"Hey! This is the little lover you hooked up with in Zhongshan County, Juyu? Tsk, tsk, tsk, how can you find a married man!"
Xie Rusu walked forward slowly and sat next to Shen Wuming naturally, looking him up and down.
"Shut up, Xie Rusu." Cao Zhuyu frowned slightly, "Young Master Shen is my best friend and the uncle of Shoutinghou Mansion."
Shen Wuming noticed that Cao Juyu didn't seem to like Xie Rusu very much.
But this seems normal, after all, every beautiful woman is not friendly to the same kind.
However, he did not agree with Cao Zhuyu's status as a close friend.
One thing is that he didn't have much friendship with this woman, and he even wanted to distance himself from her.
If it weren't for the sake of money, no one would come here today.
"Cortex, don't reject people thousands of miles away like this."
Xie Rusu smiled faintly, and then took out a piece of paper from his sleeve.
"The main reason is that I heard that you recently solved the explosion case. It should be that the Mohist attainments have improved again."
"I just have a question that I haven't solved for a long time. I wonder if I can come and ask for advice?"
She spoke loudly, as if on purpose, and immediately attracted the attention of the people around her.
After all, everyone knows that Cao Zhuyu is most likely a direct descendant of the Mo family and will be everyone's immediate boss in the future.
